title: Projective coordinate divisor and actual supported Chern adjunct
statement:
For the finite purity datum P [def-pur-conventions] and any Noetherian base T [lem-weil-pbc-finite-type-over-noetherian], suppose the projective zero section [def-pur-coordinate-section-projective-arrows] is closed. Its Cartier ideal is invertible, its dual is O(1), and its normalized supported Kummer map forgets to the positive O(1) Chern class, namely ProjectiveNormalization. At every positive prime-power exponent killing Ring P, for any invertibility witness on T and Cartier witness for the affine zero section, apply the actual open counit after compact pushforward to the affine supported arrow and precompose with inverse sectionComposition [def-pur-coordinate-section-core-arrows]. This is exactly the ordinary projective Chern adjunct [def-amb-p1-trace], with coefficient +1 as an equality of derived morphisms. No finite-type-over-field hypothesis on T is imposed.

The exact Lean statement is:

theorem coordinateSectionProjectiveTrace
    (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u}) (T : Scheme.{u})
    [IsNoetherian T] [IsClosedImmersion (projectiveZero T)] :
    ProjectiveNormalization P T ∧
    ∀ (b : ℕ) (hA : ((P.coefficients.l ^ (b + 1) : ℕ) : Ring P) = 0)
      (hT : IsUnit ((P.coefficients.l ^ (b + 1) : ℕ) : Γ(T, ⊤)))
      (hI : (sectionMap T).ker.IsInvertible),
    ((sectionComposition (Ring P) T).inv.app (Etale.ordinaryFiniteUnit (Ring P) T) ≫
      (compact (Ring P) T).map
        (restrictedSupported (Ring P) T (P.coefficients.l ^ (b + 1))
          (pow_pos (Fact.out : P.coefficients.l.Prime).pos _) hA hT hI) ≫
    (Etale.ordinaryFinitePushforward (Ring P) (ProjectiveLine T ↘ T)).map
      ((Etale.affineTraceOpenAdjunction (Ring P) T).counit.app
        ((Etale.ordinaryFiniteLine (Ring P) (P.coefficients.l ^ (b + 1)) hA
          (ProjectiveLine T))⟦(2 : ℤ)⟧)) =
      Etale.ordinaryFiniteP1ChernPushforward (Ring P) (P.coefficients.l ^ (b + 1)) hA T
        (Etale.projectiveLineTraceDatum (P.coefficients.l ^ (b + 1))
          (pow_pos (Fact.out : P.coefficients.l.Prime).pos _) (Ring P) hA T hT).chern)

source.place: Rank-one supported Cartier normalization, even twists and finite etale-origin transport; expanded parent proof steps as specified below.

proof.text: Compute the projective zero divisor in the two standard charts, with ideal frames t and 1. Their dual transition t^-1 gives O(D0)=O(1), and the ideal is Cartier. This works with nilpotents and on the empty base.

Apply the ordinary supported Kummer theorem to this Cartier divisor and its pullback along the affine chart. Boundary uniqueness identifies the selected maps with projectiveSupported and ordinarySupported. The forgetting-support clause gives the positive projective Chern map.

The supported projective sheaf restricts to zero at infinity. The open-closed exact sequence makes the actual open counit on that sheaf an isomorphism. Its naturality compares the projective supported arrow with extension of the affine one. Apply derived proper pushforward and the identity-normalized compact-support composition comparison. The composite adjunction for qs=id identifies the source unit with identity, giving exactly the first ordinary normalization equation.
